title: IKEA Recalls KULLEN 3 Drawer Chest Due to Tip-Over/ Entrapment Hazards
hazard: IKEA is voluntarily recalling KULLEN 3 drawer chest in birch and black/brown. The chest is unstable if it is not anchored to the wall, posing tip over and entrapment hazards.
remedy: Customers that have a KULLEN 3 drawer chest, that is not properly anchored to the wall, are urged to stop using it and place it in an area that children cannot access. If you have a recalled chest, please contact IKEA for a choice between two options: a refund or a free wall-attachment kit. Customers can order a free wall-attachment repair kit for self-installation or IKEA will provide a one-time, free in-home installation service. IKEA will accept in-store returns or arrange for a free pick up of the chests for a refund. Proof of purchase (receipt) is not required. To participate in the recall, please click here .

hazard: IKEA is announcing a voluntary recall of the IKEA 365+ VÄRDEFULL garlic press, article 305.781.89 only, for units sold from March 2024- May 2025. Small metal pieces can detach from the garlic press posing a laceration or ingestion risk.
remedy: Small metal pieces can detach from the garlic press posing a laceration or ingestion risk. Consumers should immediately stop using the product and return to any IKEA store for a full refund. Affected recalled product can be identified by a marking of the IKEA logo on the upper handle of the product. If you are unable to return to a store, please contact us for instructions on how to dispose of confirmed recalled product to receive a full refund. Proof of purchase (receipt) is not required to receive a full refund.
